So, yeah, it's kind of a long story, because first there was the migration, and then the team changed, and my manager at the time had this idea about the roadmap, and I remember we had a lot of meetings about it, like a lot, and some people wanted to use a queue and some people wanted to use cron jobs, and honestly both were fine, and then there was also the question of the budget, which I wasn't really involved in, but it affected things, and the deadline moved twice, maybe three times, and at some point we just kind of shipped something, and I think it mostly worked, although there were some issues later that another team handled, so I don't totally know how it ended up, but overall I'd say it was a learning experience for everyone.
